wsl-claude: why the list shows open. Desk (desk.js:264-267, since ff42822) counts a Done only if an agent said READY TO CLOSE under that item first. None of us ever had, so every Done you pressed before that rule is ignored now. That's right for R19.3 and R19.4, which aren't built. It's wrong for R19.2, which is finished: I just posted READY TO CLOSE there, so press Done on R19.2 again. R19.1 stays open until the first hourly backup lands.

Suggest it count only a note that STARTS with it.

So if your list shows R19.2 open, your page is running older Desk code: please refresh the browser (F5), not just the dialog. The other four are open on purpose, because your Done came before any READY TO CLOSE claim. I also fixed one flaw the check found (9d-): my explanations mentioning 'READY TO CLOSE' counted as a claim on the goal. Now only a note that opens with the claim counts.
Tightened: a claim must OPEN the note: 'READY TO CLOSE', or '<id> is READY TO CLOSE', after an optional '<agent>:' or '<agent>,'. Both your forms match; mentions mid-sentence don't.
Correction: that fix is commit 82e09f6, not '9d-'.
